adjudication_summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review recovered source-backed MIC/MFC and hyphal-growth activity rows from the local paper XML/PDF and Supplementary Table S1, resolved linked DBAASP assay rows against primary source locators, bounded mechanism claims to morphology-supported plasma-membrane/vacuole/cell-wall effects, and closed the prior complete-message rework ticket as caution-bearing acceptance.

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Material packet remains a separate material_extracted_with_gaps layer because structured supplementary tables were not parser-emitted, but the local supplementary PDF text was opened and used for source-reviewed Table S1 recovery.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Structural artifacts are present and strict post-repair gates were rerun; validator readiness is treated separately from publication-grade review.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: All 48 linked DBAASP assay/experiment rows match Supplementary Table S1 values and primary peptide/method evidence; two literature rows match article metadata. Primary-only C. albicans 1550 rows are retained as activity evidence even though absent from the linked snapshot.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Thirty-two source-backed peptide activity rows were emitted: 28 MIC/MFC rows from Table S1 and four hyphal-growth inhibition rows from primary results text. No current-paper toxicity assay row was fabricated from prior-work citation text.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are limited to direct morphology/TEM evidence and explicitly avoid biochemical target overclaiming.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: No blocking or major worker-2/4/6 issue remains; remaining limits are explicit nonblocking cautions.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Source-reviewed recovery closes blocking worker-2/4/6 gaps, but the material packet still records complete-with-gaps history and mechanism evidence remains morphological rather than molecular-target proof.
The current article states prior absence of hemolytic/cytotoxic activity by citing ref. 32; no current-paper mammalian toxicity assay row was emitted.
No linked_sequence_records rows were staged, but Section 2.1 gives formulas for R9F2 and (KFF)3K with amidated termini and mass-spectrometry verification.
Supplementary Table S1 includes source-supported R9F2/(KFF)3K MIC/MFC rows for C. albicans strain 1550; these are retained in activity evidence but absent from the linked DBAASP snapshot.
The paper explicitly frames TEM as morphology/dynamics evidence and notes molecular interactions are not directly observed by these methods.
Figure panels support qualitative ultrastructural localization; exact panel-level percentages were not invented.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The current paper only states absence of hemolytic and cytotoxic activity as prior work in reference 32; no current-paper local XML/PDF/supplement table contains mammalian toxicity assay values for these peptides.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Nonblocking caution: current-paper activity and mechanism values are recovered, but toxicity should not be represented as a current-paper assay row.

quality_gate_expectation: strict semantic and publication gates should pass with cautions preserved
